$Comment: Stone and rock, natural or cut: the blocks whose item is tagged Type Rock, gems left out. GatherSpeed_Stone speeds breaking them and BuildThrift_Stone spares placing them. A block joins any family by naming it in its own item Tags under ZigBlockFamily, so another mod opts its blocks in from its own files. Retune or switch it off by id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/block-families.json.
